title.text: Denser regions have more job reallocation, in and outside London
subtitle: ITL2 regions, reallocation pooled 2003–24. Correlation 0.85 across all regions; 0.65 excluding London.
Population-weighted density: density of the small area the average resident lives in. Red line = fit across all regions; navy = excluding London. Northern Ireland excluded (job flows only from 2011).
Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS, NRS and NISRA population estimates; authors' calculations.
